what_this_is: Every sentence the page builds from data. Each reason is a count or a quote. Ages are as of the day the boards were checked. The wording test runs over this file.

group_meaning.brief_ready: A new delivery-type job: posted in the last 30 days (60 for a leadership role), and not a repost of a job first posted over 90 days ago. "Ready" means the brief is ready, not that the company will buy. Ages are as of [d].
group_meaning.needs_person: Something is unclear, and the row says what. Ages are as of [d].
group_meaning.skipped: A check ruled it out. The row says which one. Ages are as of [d].

reasons.DATES_CLUSTERED: [a] of [b] postings on this board show dates no more than 14 days apart, so the dates may not show which jobs are new. A person opens two postings and checks whether the board was reposted in bulk.
reasons.NOT_READ: A posting could not be read, or the line the AI picked is not in it. A person reads it.
reasons.MODEL_UNSURE: The AI was unsure [what]. A person reads the posting.
reasons.NO_RULE_FITS: No check fits this company. A person reads it.
reasons.READ_AS_OTHER_WORK: The AI read [n] job title[s] with a delivery word here as other work.
reasons.NO_DELIVERY_OPERATION_SHOWN: The postings the AI read do not show the company running delivery, fleet or field-service work, itself or through carriers it manages.
reasons.OLDER_COPIES_OPEN: [k] delivery job[s] got a new posting here, but [each] was first posted at the company more than 90 days ago. A repost of a long-open job does not count as new.
reasons.SEASONAL: The only new delivery jobs say seasonal or temporary.
reasons.OUTSIDE_US: No delivery job read here is in the United States, or its place could not be read.
reasons.OPEN_A_WHILE: The newest posting for a job the AI read as delivery work is [nd] old.
reasons.NOTHING_NEW: The newest posting for a job the AI read as delivery work is [nd] old.
reasons.NOTHING_NEW_UNREAD: The newest posting with a delivery word in its title is [nd] old.
reasons.NONE_QUALIFY: Each new delivery job here is outside the US, seasonal, an old job reposted, or one the AI did not read as delivery work at this company.
reasons.BRIEF_READY_LEADER: New leadership role, [label] [nd] ago (leadership roles count as new for [lead] days).[more]
reasons.PLACE_UNCLEAR: The AI read a new job here as delivery work, but its place says only "[place]", so the check could not tell whether it is in the United States. A person checks.
reasons.MORE_READY: [n] more new role[s] [v] the same way.

brief.runs_operation: The AI picked this line from [lead] as proof that the company runs deliveries, routes, a fleet or field visits, itself or through carriers it manages.
brief.roles: [n] delivery job posting[ns] [where]: [r] different job[rs] in [p] location[ps].
brief.new_roles: New jobs (a posting in the last 30 days, or 60 for a leadership role): [k] of [r].
brief.set_apart: [n] delivery job postings on this board are for a second business that does different work. Left out.
brief.local_brands: [n] of [b] postings on this board are listed under other business names.
brief.not_known: Not known: company size ([boards] [t] open posting[s] in all), and whether the company is already a customer or in a deal.
brief.old_more: [m] more job[s] whose newest posting is over 90 days old.
brief.software: Delivery or dispatch software named in [lead]: [names].

notes.ask: How are these routes planned and handed to drivers today?
notes.do_not_assume: That anything is wrong, or that they are looking for software.
notes.buyers_note: The people who post driver jobs are rarely the buyers. This contact is my guess, based on the company's market.

ask_by_kind.delivery_operations_management: While you hire a [title], what happens today when a delivery runs late or fails?
ask_by_kind.driving_or_courier: While you add drivers[in_place], what happens today when a delivery or pickup runs late or fails?
ask_by_kind.dispatch_or_routing: While you hire a dispatcher, what happens today when a technician runs late or a job runs long?
ask_by_kind.fleet_management: While you hire a [title], which vehicles, drivers and jobs are tracked in one place today, and which are not?
ask_by_kind.field_technician: While you hire technicians[in_place], what happens today when a job runs long or a technician runs late?

notes.to_leader: the person this new [title] will report to, and the new hire once they start
notes.ask_tools: The posting mentions [tools]. How is a late or failed delivery handled today, and which tools are part of that?

ask_tools_by_kind.dispatch_or_routing: The posting mentions [tools]. How is a technician running late or a job running long handled today, and which tools are part of that?
ask_tools_by_kind.field_technician: The posting mentions [tools]. How is a job running long or a technician running late handled today, and which tools are part of that?
ask_tools_by_kind.fleet_management: The posting mentions [tools]. Which vehicles, drivers and jobs are tracked in one place today, and which are not?

notes.do_not_assume_tools: That anything is wrong, or that they want to replace the tools they name.
notes.to_reports: the person named in the posting's reporting line
notes.to_reports_leader: the person named in the posting's reporting line, and the new hire once they start
notes.to_note_finance: This role reports into [word]; delivery and dispatch decisions may sit with operations.
